tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs nag mo can

zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya kṛṣṇi uṣṇī ṣa nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs nag mo can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i gnas/ dam pa chos kyi pho brang na/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen pos stong nyis brgya lnga bcu dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang*/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa 'dod khams kyi lha dang*/ tshangs pa la sogs pa gzugs khams kyi lha dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das gzhan gyis mi tshugs pa'i rig sngags chen mo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so// de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgon bos phyag 'tshal te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas thal mo sbyar te/ logs shig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa 'dod khams kyi lha rnams dang*/ dge slong dang*/ dge slong ma dang*/ dge bsnyen dang*/ dge bsnyen ma dang*/ de rnams la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa'i slad du chos kyi rnam grangs gsung du gsol// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to// kun dga' bo 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang gsung bar 'gyur/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang gsung ngo*// 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyir mi ldog pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas log par dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la phyag 'tshal lo/

de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs nag mo can la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhan gyi rig sngags gcod pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor los sgyur ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhan gyi rig sngags kyi 'jigs pa dang*/ 'jigs pa brgyad dang*/ gzhan gyis dmod pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ mi yi 'jigs pa dang*/ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ gdon gyi 'jigs pa dang*/ dgra yi 'jigs pa dang*/ nad chen po brgyad kyi 'jigs pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i 'jigs pa dang*/ nad dang 'jigs pa dang*/ ma rungs pa thams cad las thar bar mdzad du gsol// rdo rje gtum mo stobs chen mo// rig sngags chen mo gzi brjid can// drag shul chen mo 'bar ba ma// rdo rje mkha' 'gro drag mo che// 'bar ba can dang gzi brjid can// mā ma kī dang 'od zer can// mche ba gtsigs dang rdo rje 'dzin// rig sngags 'dzin dang drag mo che// rig pa'i lha mo stobs mo che// lha mo chen mo nag mo dang*// ral gcig ma dang sgrol ma dang*// rig sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang*// rig pa'i lha mo thams cad dang*/ gzhan gyi rig sngags kyis gnod pa dang*/ rims nad thams cad dang*/ ma rungs pa thams cad dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang*/ mdze dang phol mig dang*/ dug dang drang srong gi gnod pa dang*/ gza' dang rgyu skar rnams kyi 'jigs pa thams cad las bdag dang rgyu sbyor ba la bsrung du gsol// oṃ kṛṣṇa uṣṇī ṣa a na a ba lo ki ta/ sarba bha dhā ya/ tshindha tshindha/ sarba dzwa ra ma nā ya/ nā sa ya nā sa ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa// oṃ a ka la mir tu ni/ bha ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ sarba buddha ni uṣṇī ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba hasti uṣṇī ṣa ba ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba gra ha ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba nakṣa ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ o sarba ku so pa ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs nag mo can/ dam pa chos kyi pho brang la mnga' mdzad ma/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dbang du sdud ma/ zhal bcu gcig ma/ phyag brgya rtsa brgyad mnga' ma/ phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin ma/ drag shul chen mo can/ gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad zlog par mdzad ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// tadya thā/ oṃ a pa ri tsi ta/ sa ha ra sa si re/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sa ha ra sarba dze ma hā tsakra/ tra sa ya tra sa ya/ kaṃ pa ya/ kaṃ pa ya/ pa ra biddhā ya/ tshindha tshindha/ bindha bindha/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs nag mo can la phyag 'tshal lo// lha ma yin gyis byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// drag shul can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab bo/ bdud thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab bo/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab bo/ tshangs pa dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ ma hā de bas byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab ba bo// dbang phyug chen po dang*/ tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// klu'i rgyal po dang klu thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// srin po thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// gnod sbyin thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// 'byung po thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// yi dwags thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// rig sngags thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// lha thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// dur khrod na gnas par mos pa ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags rdo rje'i ral gris bcad do// phur bus gad ba bo// oṃ uṣṇī ṣa sarba ta tha ga ta a dhi ṣṭha na a dhiṣṭhī te hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ sa man tra pra bhan dza na dza ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba tsakra ga na sa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba sma ra se na pra bhan dza ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba sha truṃ bha uṣṇī ṣa pa ra ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ti ha ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba sang ha re kṣa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ba la ba te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ te dzo ba ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ti sang kha re hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhā ra mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dza li te dza sa na ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ dza ye bi dza ye ma hā tsakra tha re ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra uṣṇī ṣa a pa ra tsi ta hūṃ phaṭa/ dza li ti pri kha re hūṃ phaṭa/ dzā la dzā la/ khanda khanda/ so me so me/ dzante dzante/ pa ri ba dha ya/ na sa ni na sa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a su bha ya/ birya uṣṇī ṣa pa ra ni hūṃ phaṭa/ o sarba ma he sa ra bi nā ya ga ku mā rā ya/ bu ha ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ dharma ru tra dha rā ya pa ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki ni bi kro dha ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ o sarba rakṣa sarba bha ya uṣṇī ṣa pa ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhi da sa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba yakṣa sarba bha ya uṣṇī ṣa pa ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bai te sa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba buddha tra sa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bha ba tra ha ra sa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ga ni dhe ba bha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ pra bhan dza ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba buddha ma hā kro dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ma tri ga ni bi dha na sa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba tre lo kya pra ma tha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs nag mo can dam pa chos kyi pho brang la mnga' mdzad ma/ gzhan gyi rig sngags kyis gnod pas na ba dang*/ rims kyis na ba dang*/ mgo bo na ba dang*/ yan lag na ba dang*/ nying lag na ba dang*/ lhog pas na ba dang*/ mdzes na ba dang*/ rgyu nad kyis nad dang*/ lto na ba dang*/ rked pa na ba dang*/ chu so na ba dang*/ brla na ba dang*/ rje ngar na ba dang*/ mig nad kyis na ba dang*/

mi ma yin pa'i nad kyis na ba dang*/ gdon gyis na ba dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i nad dang*/ 'byung po'i nad thams cad las bdag la bsrung du gsol/ tadya thā/ oṃ u pi sha a pa ra tsi ta/ ma hā kro dha mu ra te/ a tsa le a tsa le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ be ra be ra/ badzra dha ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ pa ra bidyā maṇi tsa ra ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gsang sngags chen mo 'di ni gro ga'am ras sam/ shing shun la bris te lus sam mgul du btags na/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du de la rgyal po'i 'jigs pas mi tshugs/ dgra'i 'jigs pas mi tshugs/ me'i 'jigs pas mi tshugs/ chu'i 'jigs pas mi tshugs/ nad chen po brgyad kyi 'jigs pas mi tshugs/ gzhan gyi rig sngags kyi dmod pas mi tshugs/ btsan gyi 'jigs pas mi tshugs/ gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pas mi tshugs/ dug gi 'jigs pas mi tshugs/ sbrul gyi 'jigs pas mi tshugs/ 'byung po'i 'jigs pas mi tshugs/ gdon thams cad kyi 'jigs pas mi tshugs/ gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad dang*/ gnod byed thams cad kyis mi tshugs shing gnod par mi 'gyur ro// tadya thā/ oṃ uṣṇī ṣa pi lo ki te mo 'u te/ bi ma le uṣṇī ṣa pa ri shuddhe/ badzra badzra bha dzwa la ga ra le/ ma hā be ra du dha ra ṇi/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ badzra uṣṇī ṣa bi ma le sarba ya na pa ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru.uṣṇī ṣa hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs nag mo can gzung ba'am/ klog pa'am/ yongs su 'dzin pa'am/ gzhan la rgya cher ston pa'am/ de dag thams cad la gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad kyis mi tshugs so/ 'byung po'i gdon thams cad kyis mi tshugs/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pas mi tshugs/ gdon thams cad dang gegs dang 'jigs pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs/

lha thams cad dang*/ gdon gegs dang*/ log 'dren thams cad kyis yid du 'ong ba dang dga' bar 'gyur ro// rdo rje'i rigs 'bum phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhis kyang de la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sbed par 'gyur ro// de nas kun dga' bo stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ thal mo sbyar nas logs shig tu 'dug ste/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba'i slad du gzungs chen mo 'di gsungs pa legs so legs so// rjes su yi rang ngo de skad ces gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no// de de bzhin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gzungs chen po 'di bka' bstsal pa dang*/ lha thams cad dang*/ dge slong thams cad dang*/ lha dang*/ klu dang lha ma yin dang*/ mi dang*/ gnod sbyin thams cad dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs nag mo can zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/
